digest.component_or_area: test suite / source scanning and build attestation
propositions: test_shipped_surfaces_name_no_retired_bridge_command fails with UnicodeDecodeError when scanning non-UTF-8 binaries (esbuild Mach-O) under src/rebar that are in .gitignore
test_hook_falls_back_to_git_when_env_unset fails when run in a shallow promisor clone lacking historical Git objects
shipped-surface contract test must enumerate only tracked/package-shipped textual inputs, not arbitrary working-tree artifacts, and still detect stale command tokens
provenance fallback test must construct a self-contained Git fixture with complete objects rather than depend on audit checkout's full object database
both tests require negative controls proving they handle ignored binaries and shallow checkouts without silent skip or overly broad error suppression
